taskCards.title: BC-006: Test coverage
taskCards.prompt:
Backlog item BC-006 — Implement user management CRUD

Description: Complete user persistence, application services, and REST endpoints so trainers can register, view, update, deactivate, and list users without exposing passwords.
Scope: `build.gradle.kts`, `src/main/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/users/`, `src/main/resources/db/migration/V3__Add_Users_Table.sql`, `src/test/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/users/`

Write TDD tests covering acceptance criteria before or after implementation per project policy.
acceptanceCriteria: Test covers: `POST /api/v1/users` returns `201 Created` for valid input and never serializes a password
Test covers: A duplicate email returns `409 Conflict` and does not create a second user
Test covers: Passwords are persisted as BCrypt hashes and are never stored in plain text
Test covers: `GET /api/v1/users/{id}` returns `404 Not Found` for an unknown identifier
Test covers: `Email`, `Password`, and `PhoneNumber` reject invalid values through their domain invariants
Test covers: Unit, `@WebMvcTest`, and `@DataJpaTest` coverage exists for the implemented user flows
